project_info.theme: contemporary cinematic fashion portrait in a luxury elevator
project_info.color_palette: muted graphite, black, brushed steel, and soft white ceiling light

main_subject.description: an adult woman with softly waved dark hair wearing a sleek muted-graphite satin gown with a wrapped bodice and long flowing skirt
main_subject.pose_and_expression: standing comfortably inside the elevator with a subtle confident smile and relaxed hands

composition_elements.foreground: graphite satin folds and reflective elevator floor
composition_elements.background: brushed-metal elevator interior, mirror reflections, and soft ceiling light panels
composition_elements.visual_hierarchy: adult subject face and gown silhouette, mirror repetitions, then geometric elevator lines

lighting_and_atmosphere.lighting: soft diffuse overhead ceiling light balanced by gentle reflected fill from mirror panels

technical_specs.rendering: realistic satin sheen, natural skin texture, controlled mirror reflections, clean low-noise shadows, subtle fine grain

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Contemporary cinematic fashion portrait of an adult woman standing inside a luxury brushed-metal elevator. She wears a sleek satin gown in a muted graphite tone with a wrapped bodice and long flowing skirt, and gives a subtle confident smile. Include soft ceiling light panels and restrained mirror reflections that repeat the elevator interior. Shoot an eye-level full-length portrait with realistic satin sheen, natural skin texture, clean geometric architecture, controlled reflections, and a quiet premium cinematic mood.
prompt.negative_prompt: minor, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized pose, nudity, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, distorted reflections, extra fingers, deformed, watermark, logo, readable text
